newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares dive 3.9 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares dive 3.9 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: Istanbul shares sharply extended morning losses on Thursday afternoon as profit-taking accelerated after the recent strong rallies, brokers said.
The IMKB-100 plunged to a low of 76,421.09 at mid-session, down 3.9 percent from Wednesday's sixth consequtive all-time high close of 79,511.82. It then rebounded to above 77,000 on reaction buys.
The index which had eased 0.85 percent in the morning, had surged 22.7 percent from September 13 to Wednesday, breaking six records in a row since last Tuesday.
